keyVerseDR: "A prophet is not without honour, but in his own country..." (Mk 6:4)

level1.title: Jesus Goes Home
level1.story: Jesus went home to Nazareth to teach. The people said, "Isn't He just the carpenter?" They did not believe, so He did few miracles there.
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
questions: How can you show you believe?
actions: Be kind to people near me
level1.prayer: Jesus, I believe in You. Amen.

activity.title: The four Gospels
activity.intro: The Gospels tell us who Jesus is. Number them in order.

level2.title: A Prophet Without Honor
level2.story: Jesus came to His own country with His disciples and taught in the synagogue on the sabbath. Many were astonished and said, "Is not this the carpenter, the son of Mary?" They were scandalized because they knew His family. Jesus said, "A prophet is not without honour, but in his own country." He could do no miracles there except heal a few sick people, and He wondered at their unbelief.
level2.keyLine: A prophet is not without honour, but in his own country.
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: How can familiarity make us miss God?
level2.prayer: Jesus, open my eyes to see who You are. Amen.

activity.title: What do we believe?
items: Jesus is the Son of God and the son of Mary.
The people of Nazareth all believed in Jesus.
